memoryRule: a bounded directional sweep remains neutral until release; each release makes every local surface patch inherit from its neighbour in the sweep direction, and later beats rebuild from the inherited terrain
interactionRule: pointerdown arms a directional sweep without changing geometry; pointermove only previews the gesture; bounded pointerup commits one propagation beat; Enter, Space, or the pulse control uses a deterministic sweep; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: exposure shutters, granular bodies, and cellular quorum membrane -> one continuous spatial terrain with folded height, phase, and inherited local relief
encounterRupture: observe-and-depart, hold-and-release, and three-cell witness quorum -> one directional drag whose endpoint is refused and whose release advances a local-neighbour rule
temporalRupture: remote aperture, pressure collapse, and quorum ledger -> four inherited propagation beats reconstructed as a causal surface history
mediumRupture: WebGPU veil over discrete Canvas projections -> WebGPU veil over a continuous Canvas 2D terrain renderer with no privileged cells
renderer: WebGPU propagation surface with Canvas 2D fallback
changedRule: The viewer does not select a place. A direction is released, and each patch copies a neighbour's height and phase, making a continuous crease travel through the surface.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one folded topographic terrain. A valid sweep changes actual height, phase, fold, depth, and inheritance throughout the mesh; the touched endpoint is not a special role.
falsifier: Delete if arming changes geometry, if the endpoint directly becomes the answer, if the work reads as a wireframe grid or particle display, if neighbour inheritance is cosmetic, if later beats reset, or if exact lifting fails.
deletionCondition: Delete v033 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish one continuous terrain from the previous cells, grains, and shutters, or if the directional drag is only a disguised button.
promotion: candidate / held pending browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
